page.title: Suppressions
page.description: Recipients on this list are rejected at every send entry point (hard bounce and complaint events are added automatically per system settings, and addresses can also be added manually).

empty.noRecordsDesc: Hard bounce and complaint events are added here automatically per system settings; you can also block addresses you no longer want to send to.

addModal.title: Add Suppression
addModal.hint: Once added, the address is rejected immediately at every send entry point (400 recipient_suppressed); if a hard bounce or complaint event arrives after removal, it is added back automatically.

removeModal.title: Remove Suppression
removeModal.note: The address can receive mail again immediately after removal; if a hard bounce or complaint event arrives later, it is added back automatically per system settings.
